Dehydrated Oregano Leaves Supplier for Global B2B Buyers

Dehydrated oregano leaves are a staple for pizza makers, seasoning houses, sauce producers and foodservice distributors. Tradenest Naturals supplies clean, aromatic cut oregano from India to food manufacturers, restaurants, importers and private label brands. The leaves keep a warm herbal aroma and a savory, slightly bitter taste, so buyers can hold flavor steady from one production batch to the next. We supply wholesale dehydrated oregano leaves in bulk, standard packs, and customized private label formats. Our team also helps with specification review, samples, packaging development and export documentation. Buyers can request a quotation based on quantity, mesh size, packaging, destination, and quality requirements.

Product Overview

Dehydrated oregano leaves come from carefully selected oregano herbs. We clean and dry the leaves under controlled processing conditions. Next, we remove unwanted foreign matter and sieve the product to meet the agreed particle-size requirement. This process creates a practical ingredient with improved storage stability and convenient handling. The product works well in dry seasoning systems and prepared food applications. It can also provide a recognizable Mediterranean-style herbal note. Moreover, buyers can use the leaves alone or combine them with basil, thyme, rosemary, garlic, onion, chili, and pepper.
  • Natural oregano leaf character for savory food products
  • Suitable for wholesale dehydrated oregano leaves requirements
  • Available in multiple mesh sizes and packaging formats
  • Designed for foodservice, manufacturing, and export supply
  • Suitable for standard or customer-specific specifications

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals manages the supply process from raw material sourcing to final packing. We select suitable oregano leaves based on appearance, aroma, cleanliness, and application needs. Then, we clean the material to reduce physical impurities before dehydration. Controlled dehydration reduces moisture while helping preserve the herb’s natural flavor profile. After drying, we inspect and sieve the leaves. We can supply cut leaves, rubbed leaves, or other agreed particle sizes. Finally, we pack the finished product in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. Our facility also supports grinding, blending, sieving, bulk packing, and private label packing. As a result, buyers can source a complete oregano ingredient solution from one manufacturing partner. Custom blending remains available for pizza seasoning, pasta seasoning, snack seasoning, and other dry mixes.

Typical Technical Specifications

Specifications can vary by crop, season, processing method, and buyer requirements. The following values represent typical commercial targets for standard dehydrated oregano leaves. We confirm final specifications before production and shipment.
  • Mesh size: 8-16 mesh cut leaves
  • Moisture content: ≤ 8%
  • HS code: 1211.90
  • Appearance: green to greyish-green dried oregano leaves
  • Flavor: characteristic herbal, warm, slightly bitter, and savory
  • Foreign matter: controlled according to the agreed product specification
  • Processing: cleaned, dehydrated, sieved, and packed
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. If your market or customer needs specific analytical parameters, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Please state these requirements before order confirmation so they can be planned into the schedule.

Quality Standards and Documentation

Quality begins with responsible raw material selection. We follow documented operating practices for cleaning, dehydration, sieving, inspection, and packing. In addition, batch identification supports traceability throughout the supply chain. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Each shipment is supported with standard export paperwork, such as the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin. Tell us early which documents your destination market requires, and we will confirm what can be provided. Before dispatch, we check appearance, aroma, moisture, particle size and packaging condition against the agreed specification. Where a buyer needs independent results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Importers and distributors therefore get clear information before the goods leave India.

Applications

Dehydrated oregano leaves offer convenient flavor delivery across many food categories. They reduce preparation work and support repeatable recipes. Therefore, they suit both industrial production and professional kitchens.
  • Pizza, pasta, and Italian-style sauces
  • Dry seasoning blends and herb mixtures
  • Snack coatings, namkeen, and savory extruded products
  • Soups, ready-to-cook meals, and instant food mixes
  • Marinades, meat products, and poultry seasoning
  • Salad dressings, dips, and table seasoning
  • Bakery products, crackers, and savory biscuits
  • Restaurant, hotel, café, and cloud-kitchen recipes

Buyer Value

Buying dehydrated oregano leaves in bulk can simplify procurement and improve production planning. The dried format provides longer storage than fresh herbs when buyers follow suitable conditions. Also, the product helps reduce daily washing, chopping, and preparation requirements.
  • Longer usable storage than fresh oregano under proper conditions
  • Consistent ingredient availability across the year
  • Lower preparation labor for commercial kitchens
  • Efficient transport because dehydration reduces product weight
  • Flexible sizing for seasoning, foodservice, and industrial recipes
  • Better purchasing efficiency for recurring wholesale orders
  • Private label and export packing support from one supplier

Packaging and Shelf Life

We use food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging to protect the leaves during storage and transport. Packaging helps limit exposure to humidity, contamination, light, and physical damage. Each shipment can include batch details, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions, and applicable regulatory information. Typical shelf life is 18 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. However, the final shelf life depends on packaging, moisture control, storage temperature, and customer requirements. We can review longer or customer-specific shelf-life expectations before production. Available options include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We also offer bulk bags, export cartons, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, custom printed packaging, and private label formats. In short, we can support samples, retail-ready units, foodservice packs, and industrial quantities.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Quote Process

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated oregano leaves? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This makes it practical to start with a trial order before moving to regular bulk volumes. Samples are available on request. What is the typical lead time? Lead time depends on order size, packaging and destination. Custom packaging, private label artwork, third-party testing or larger export volumes may add time. We confirm the dispatch schedule in writing before accepting the order. How do I request a sample or quote? Send your required quantity, destination country, preferred mesh, packaging, target specification, and application. Also share any documentation or testing needs for your market. Our team will review the request and provide available sample, pricing, MOQ, lead time, and shipping information.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals operates as a dehydrated oregano leaves manufacturer, exporter, and B2B food ingredient partner. We combine ingredient sourcing, dehydration, sieving, blending, bulk packing, and private label support. Therefore, buyers can build a stable supply program with fewer coordination points. We support importers seeking a bulk dehydrated oregano leaves supplier India, as well as distributors sourcing dehydrated oregano leaves in bulk for international markets. Our commercial team focuses on clear communication, practical specifications, and dependable order management. Moreover, our flexible approach supports food manufacturers, restaurants, emerging brands, and established exporters. For current dehydrated oregano leaves price information, request a quotation based on your exact requirement. Prices may change with crop availability, order volume, mesh size, packaging, optional third-party testing, and freight terms. We provide a transparent commercial proposal after reviewing these details.

Supply Summary

Choose Tradenest Naturals for clean, aromatic, and versatile dehydrated oregano leaves. We offer scalable supply, practical packaging, and professional export support. Contact us today to request a sample, technical specification, or wholesale quotation.
